title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our web design services and process.

items.question: What is GDT DevSur and what projects do you develop?
items.answer: GDT DevSur (Grupo Desarrollo Tecnológico DevSur) is a Chilean web design, web development, and IT agency. We build institutional sites, landing pages, self-manageable platforms, web apps, and AI integrations — always custom, with no templates or WordPress.

items.question: What services does GDT DevSur offer?
items.answer: Custom premium web design, custom web apps and software, multilingual websites, custom admin panels, Google and AI optimization (technical SEO + GEO), and redesign, maintenance, and support for existing sites.

items.question: What makes GDT DevSur different from other agencies?
items.answer: High-impact custom design, top-tier technology (Astro/Next.js), and proven experience. Faster, more secure sites ready for Google and AI assistants.

items.question: How much does a professional website cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope. Landing pages, institutional sites, and custom platforms have different ranges. We work in the premium segment: a concrete proposal after a no-obligation consultation.

items.question: How long does it take to develop a website?
items.answer: Landing: 2–3 weeks. Institutional site: 4–6 weeks. Corporate with custom features: 6–10 weeks. Complex platforms: 8–14 weeks.

items.question: Where is GDT DevSur based and where do you work?
items.answer: GDT DevSur is an agency based in Chile. We work remotely with companies across Chile and abroad. Video calls, shared staging servers, and direct communication.

items.question: Can I edit content without coding?
items.answer: Yes. Each project can include a custom admin panel to configure, add, and edit all content without touching code.

items.question: How do I contact GDT DevSur?
items.answer: Email us at info@gdtdevsur.cl, call or message us on WhatsApp at +56 9 95995720, or fill out the contact form at gdtdevsur.cl to request a no-obligation quote.
